Usage and technical data: such as IP address, approximate location derived from IP, device and browser type, timestamps, pages or endpoints accessed, workflow execution metadata, Credit charges, API request metadata, support tickets, and in-product analytics needed to operate and improve the service.

Payment and billing data: such as billing contact details, transaction references, tax identifiers where required, PayPal subscription identifiers, and payment status. intro.title: Introduction
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy explains how the operator of AI Agents Hub (aiagents-hub.vn and api.aiagents-hub.vn) uses HTTP cookies and similar storage on your device when you use our websites, dashboards, and APIs.

It should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which describes personal data processing more broadly. Where this page refers to "cookies", we include comparable technologies such as local storage when they serve a similar role, unless noted otherwise.

We minimize data collection and rely on strictly necessary cookies for core security and session management. Non-essential cookies or analytics run only where compatible with our product configuration and applicable law.

what_are_cookies.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by a web server. First-party cookies are set by domains we control (for example aiagents-hub.vn or api.aiagents-hub.vn). Third-party cookies may be set by embedded services or providers when you use certain features.

Cookies can be session cookies (removed when you close the browser) or persistent cookies (stored until they expire or you delete them). Attributes such as HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite help limit how cookies are accessed and sent across sites.

purposes.title: Why we use cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies to: keep you signed in securely; protect accounts against abuse; complete OAuth and OTP handshakes; remember UI preferences where we store them in cookies; and operate diagnostics that keep the Platform reliable.

We classify cookies as strictly necessary (required for security and basic operation), functional (improving experience, such as wallet state), and, where enabled, analytics (aggregate insight). We do not use cookies to sell personal information in the conventional sense described in our Privacy Policy.

If you use optional wallet or DID linking, pairing libraries may set additional device storage. Those providers process data under their own policies. Wallet linking is not required to build or run agents.

third_party.title: Third-party and infrastructure
paragraphs: Our infrastructure (for example edge networks and observability) may emit technical cookies or identifiers needed for load balancing, bot management, or resilience. Payment processors may set cookies when you complete checkout on their pages.

We do not intentionally load third-party advertising trackers on core API or dashboard surfaces for behavioral profiling. If we introduce optional analytics or marketing cookies that require consent in your region, we will describe them here and provide controls where required.

control.title: Your choices and browser controls
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies will prevent sign-in or may break security-sensitive flows.

Industry opt-out tools for interest-based ads are generally not central to our API platform; if you enable "Do Not Track" or Global Privacy Control, we treat those signals where our stack supports them, but some features may still require necessary cookies to function.

one-platform-one-credit-unlimited-models.title: One Platform, One Credit, Unlimited Models
one-platform-one-credit-unlimited-models.excerpt: Why we bill completed agent work in Credits — so you know what a run costs before it runs.
body: AI Agents Hub is not a model reseller. Customers should see one question: what does this job cost, and did the agent finish it?
The plan pays for the workspace — builder, sharing, webhooks, cron, and support. Credits pay for agent runs. Need SLA / SSO? That's a contract — not a fifth card.
Faster or deeper models are a per-job choice, not a reason to change plans. Free $0, Starter $4.9, Pro $19.9, Business $99.9.
Included Credits expire each period. Starter and above can buy more. Free is a trial of the builder, not the product we live on.

build-your-first-agent-workflow.title: Build your first agent workflow
build-your-first-agent-workflow.excerpt: Trigger, agent, optional tools — then a Credit estimate before anything expensive runs.
body: Open Workflows and start from a blank canvas. The first useful graph is small: a chat or webhook trigger, an agent node, and a destination (a reply, an HTTP call, or a human review).
Configure the agent with a prompt that describes the job, not the model. Attach memory if the conversation should remember the last turns. Attach RAG if the answer should cite your documents.
Run once from the editor. You should see an estimate in Credits, then an execution log. If the result is wrong, fix the prompt or the tools — not the pricing page.
When the graph is stable, turn on a webhook or cron. The same Credit wallet pays, whether you click Execute or an external system POSTs in.

agents-rag-memory-and-tools.title: Agents, RAG, memory, and tools
agents-rag-memory-and-tools.excerpt: The node families we actually run: agent loops, retrieval, session memory, and database lookups.
body: An agent node is a loop: the model can call tools, read memory, and come back with an answer. A reasoning agent adds a more governed loop when you need extra checks before acting.
RAG is two jobs. Save RAG ingests documents (including PDFs) into Vectorize. Get RAG retrieves chunks at query time. Keep those graphs boring and observable; retrieval quality beats prompt poetry.
Simple memory holds a session window. Vectorize memory is for longer semantic recall. Get DB Info reaches D1 or Oracle when the agent must ground itself in structured data.
None of these are sold as separate SKUs. They consume Credits when they call models. Storage and queues stay inside the plan plus quotas.

webhooks-cron-and-hosted-chat.title: Webhooks, cron, and hosted chat
webhooks-cron-and-hosted-chat.excerpt: One graph, three ways in. The Credit meter does not care which door you used.
body: A webhook trigger exposes an HTTP path on api.aiagents-hub.vn. Authenticate with a Bearer token, POST a JSON body, and let downstream nodes read the payload.
Cron is the same graph on a schedule. Use it for digests, syncs, and anything that should not wait for a human to click Run.
Hosted chat is for operators and end users who should talk to the agent without opening the canvas. It still bills Credits to the workspace.
Design failure the same way in all three: timeouts, retries we eat versus usage you pay, and logs a human can read at 2 a.m.

sharing-workflows-and-royalties.title: Sharing workflows and royalties
sharing-workflows-and-royalties.excerpt: Publish a graph. When someone else runs it, they pay Credits; you earn a royalty.
body: A shared workflow is still your design. When another workspace runs it, they are charged Credits for the AI usage plus a royalty percentage you configure.
The runner pays the extra. You receive earnings on a separate ledger (payouts are not the same as the Credit wallet). The Hub does not take the royalty out of its own model cost.
This only works if the graph is understandable: clear inputs, honest estimates, and no hidden side effects. Treat a shared workflow like an API you would be proud to version.
If you do not want others to run your graph, keep it private. Sharing is a product feature, not a requirement.

subscription-credits-and-enterprise.title: Subscription, Credits, and Enterprise
subscription-credits-and-enterprise.excerpt: Three layers of revenue — and why we keep them separate on purpose.
body: Free is how you try the builder. Included Credits are small and expire. We do not design Free as the main product.
Starter $4.9 unlocks sharing, webhooks, cron, and buying Credits. Pro $19.9 is for teams running agents every day. Business $99.9 is for higher volume.
Need SLA, SSO, or a company invoice? That's a contract — contact us, not a fifth card on /packages.
Pick a plan for the work you need done. Hit a limit? Top up Credits or upgrade — don't wait for a surprise bill.
